t: This release adds a new API, SearchResources, which enable users to search through metadata and content of folders, documents, document versions and comments in a WorkDocs site.
Doc only update for the WorkDocs APIs.
Added 2 new document related operations, DeleteDocumentVersion and RestoreDocumentVersions.
